page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs (4 physical cores, 2 threads per core) running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 30.0 GB of system memory. The instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA A10 GPU based on the Ampere architecture, providing 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying on network-attached storage options, and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In terms of performance, the instance demonstrates top-tier capabilities in LLM inference benchmarks. For a small 135M model, it achieves prompt processing speeds of 9665.83 tokens per second and text generation speeds of 456.78 tokens per second. For a medium 7B model, it delivers 2504.89 tokens per second for prompt processing and 90.71 tokens per second for text generation. Other CPU and memory benchmarks, such as Geekbench (1580.0 single-core, 5901.0 multi-core) and Passmark CPU (11364.98), fall within the average tier. Redis SET operations represent a relative bottleneck, performing in the bottom 25% at 7.93 million operations per second.

This hardware profile offers a cost-efficient entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads that require dedicated Intel Xeon CPU resources and Ampere-generation graphics acceleration without the overhead of massive multi-GPU configurations. The absence of local storage means storage costs are decoupled from the instance itself. It is highly suitable for small to medium LLM inference, ray tracing, image processing, and general GPU-assisted compute tasks.
